map.按 GB 4789.2，取 30–300 菌落平板，CFU/g(mL) = 同稀: Per GB 4789.2, take plates with 30–300 colonies: CFU/g(mL) = mean of the two plates at the same dilution ÷ (dilution × inoculum); outside that range use the next dilution or the weighted formula.
map.第一稀释度两板 156、168（均落 30–300），均值 162，稀释 10⁻: The two plates at the first dilution read 156 and 168 (both within 30–300), mean 162, dilution 10⁻¹, inoculum 1 mL: aerobic plate count = 162/(10⁻¹ × 1) ≈ 1.6×10³ CFU/g.
map.为什么限定 30–300？: Why is the count limited to 30–300?
map.此区间计数误差最小；<30 或 >300 统计偏差大，应取相邻稀释度重算。: Counting error is smallest in this range; below 30 or above 300 the statistical bias is large, so recount at an adjacent dilution.
map.菌落总数代表致病吗？: Does the plate count indicate pathogenicity?
map.不直接代表致病菌，是卫生指示菌；过高提示加工/储运污染风险。: Not directly: it is a hygiene indicator organism count, and a high value points to contamination risk in processing, storage or transport.
